effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: Add 1 card from your Deck to your hand that includes "Toon" in its card name, or is named "Manga Ryu-Ran".
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the effect resolves with no "Toon" card left in the Deck, the goat script proves the failed search by revealing the Deck (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script never reveals. The printed text is behaviourally unchanged.

changes.historical_text: Add 1 card from your Deck to your hand that includes "Toon" in its card name, or is named "Manga Ryu-Ran".
changes.summary: Separate per-card ruling: the goat script drops the modern requirement that a "Toon" card exist in the Deck for activation ('if chk==0 then return Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil) end' -> 'return true'), so the Normal Spell can be activated with nothing to fetch. Nothing in the packet dates when this card lost that allowance, so the chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: Baseline implements lineage v0 (TP6-EN002, 2005-06-01), the earliest English text in the packet. Trailing v0 -> v2 (LCYW-EN116 2012, DASA-EN043 2018) is cosmetic archetype formalisation: 'card that includes "Toon" in its card name, or is named "Manga Ryu-Ran"' -> '"Toon" card'. The scripts prove it: both filter on the same Toon setcode (goat writes the literal 0x62 where modern writes the SET_TOON constant), so "Manga Ryu-Ran" is matched in both and the search pool is unchanged. Reveal and relaxed activation are recorded separately because only the reveal has sourced bounds; the intermediate state needs no implementation, as GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) both precede 2011-02-02.
